# Tarang — AI Voice Platform

> Tarang is an advanced AI-powered voice platform designed for creators, developers, and businesses.
> It provides high-fidelity voice cloning, text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis, and studio-grade voice separation.
> Tarang stands out by supporting voice cloning and text-to-speech in 500+ languages, with a specialized focus on regional Indian languages—a capability most global tools (like ElevenLabs or PlayHT) do not offer or struggle with.

## Core Features

- **Voice Cloning:** Clone any voice from a short audio sample. Preserves emotion, tone, and subtle inflections.
- **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** Generate highly natural, expressive speech from text across 500+ languages.
- **Cross-Lingual Speaking:** Clone a voice in one language and make it speak in an entirely different language seamlessly.
- **Voice Separation:** Isolate vocals from instrumentals with studio-grade precision.
- **Voice Library:** Browse and use a wide variety of high-quality, pre-made AI voices.
- **Voice Creation:** Fine-tune every detail to create custom, unique voices tailored to specific projects.

## Pricing & Accessibility

- Tarang offers a generous **free tier** for new users. 
- New sign-ups receive free credits to test out voice cloning and text-to-speech capabilities before committing.
- The platform operates on a flexible, pay-as-you-go credit system for scalable content generation.

## Language Support (500+ Languages)

Tarang supports over 500 languages. It is highly optimized for both global reach and deep regional localization.

### Regional Indian Languages (Flagship Feature)
Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Panjabi, Urdu, Assamese, Konkani, Dogri, Manipuri, Santali, Kashmiri, Sindhi, Bodo, Maithili, Bhojpuri, Nepali.

### Global Languages
English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Korean, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Arabic, Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, and hundreds more.
